title: coordinated-ephemeral-quarantine-and-slo-hedge
author: Priya Menon
description: Context: A production incident on 2026-02-22 exposed a gap in how short-lived regional overloads cause cascading circuit state flips and aggressive evictions. Customer-facing symptoms were increased 5xx rate and tail latency spikes for small, transient traffic surges. Motivation: introduce a lightweight, coordinated ephemeral-quarantine window per node-pool that (1) hedges SLO enforcement for very short bursts, (2) delays aggressive eviction and circuit hardening until a sustained degradation pulse is observed, and (3) coalesces concurrent circuit transitions to avoid thrashing across routing surfaces. This PR implements the ephemeral quarantine controller, a new 'circuit coalescer' library that batches circuit transitions within a sliding window, and SLO-hedge policy flags that enable soft thresholds for 30s by default. Changes: - runtime/eviction/quarantine: new controller that tracks per-pool transient-penalty counters and exposes a quorum-safe quiesce API - runtime/circuit/coalescer: library that groups circuit state changes and publishes aggregated intents rather than immediate flips - routing/fallback: updated soft-fallback logic to respect quarantine windows and defer permanent fallback until window expiry - observability: new metrics (quarantine_window_active, coalesced_transitions_count, hedged_slo_decisions) and dashboards - integration-tests: new e2e scenario that simulates 10s/30s bursts with mixed routing and asserts no-eviction within quarantine unless sustained breach - docs: design note and operator guide added. Checklist: - [x] design doc (linked) - [x] unit tests for coalescer - [x] e2e integration tests - [x] perf microbench for coalescer path - [x] rollout plan and kill-switch (feature flag) - [x] added observability queries and alerts Rollout plan: gate behind runtime feature flag "ephemeral_quarantine_v1" and enable for 10% of traffic on Dedicated clusters for 24h, monitor hedged_slo_decisions and regional 95th latency. If safe, increase to 50% then full rollout. If quarantine-window leads to missed SLOs, disable flag and revert. Related work: ENG-1984 (regional failover after surge), ENG-2051 (circuit-state persistence improvements).

comments: Marco Alvarez: Nice approach. Two asks: (1) can we add a Prometheus label to correlate quarantine windows with pod/node IDs? (2) please ensure coalescer has bounded memory for pathological transition storms.
Author (Priya Menon): Added node_id label on quarantine metrics and implemented an LRU aging cap in coalescer; documented the cap in code comments and tests. PTAL.
Yvonne Chen: Integration test looks good. Suggest toggling the window to 10s in a test variant to verify shorter hedges behave correctly.
Author: Added a parametric test for 10s/30s/60s windows and included assertions for both no-eviction and eventual fallback behavior.
Arjun Patel: Can you confirm the feature-flag default is off in main and that we have a fast kill switch if rollout goes wrong?
Author: Feature flag default is OFF; console API support added for immediate disable and metrics will emit 'quarantine_disabled' event on toggle.
release_notes: Introduce ephemeral quarantine controller and circuit coalescer to reduce eviction thrash during transient regional surges. Feature gated and rolled out gradually. See operator guide for toggles and monitoring queries.
notes_for_oncall: If regional 5xx or 95th latency rises after enabling, first check 'quarantine_window_active' and 'coalesced_transitions_count'. Toggle 'ephemeral_quarantine_v1' to off to bypass hedging. The kill switch is immediate in the console and emits 'quarantine_disabled' event in audit logs.
